verdict.rationale: Helicone is an LLM observability platform, so in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions about a user's logged data is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence covers dashboards, HQL querying, alerts and sessions, none of which is AI-generated insight. Webhook-driven 'real-time evaluation' is a building block for users to score responses externally, not a built-in feature that produces insights or suggestions, so the evidence documents no such capability.
